purpose: Owner review of Number Lab's visual code redesign (shape carries family, one dominant colour plate carries tier, a dark medallion with a white numeral confirms, glow is state-only), including a controller-caught follow-up fix: the renderer's atlas position map keyed Family B by ASCII tier labels (B1/B3/B9/B27) instead of the tile's actual Thai-numeral tier value, so every Family-B tile in NEXT/HOLD/the board silently fell back to the Family-A tier-1 cell and rendered in the square frame instead of the round lotus frame.
selection: Every file here is copied from number-lab-app/'s runtime ship list; service-worker.js is omitted and the registration call in index.html has been neutralised so the staged copy registers no service worker.
publishStatus: Not publishable: number-lab-app has no destination in release/registry.json and no deployment repository. This is a staging preview only.
